name: PrioritySyncCursors
description: One row per SyncPrioritySubforms scope (contacts, payments): where an unfinished read stopped, so the next run continues there.

columns.name: runId
columns.description: SyncRuns.runId that started the current pass

columns.name: cursor
columns.description: Resume state: {lastCustomerKey} for contacts; {listSkip, pendingReceipts:[IVNUM], doneCount} for payments

columns.name: pendingCount
columns.description: Items still to read in this pass

columns.name: lastFullReadAt
columns.description: When the last complete read of this scope finished (needed before deletedInSource)
